user.title: Connect a Honeywell M-Bus meter
user.description: Enter the raw TCP serial bridge endpoint and one primary address. Stop other readers on this bus first. Configure the gateway UART separately: 8E1, no handshake, matching baud rate. No management password is needed.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Only the same meter can replace this endpoint. Existing entity identities are retained.

error.cannot_connect: No valid, fresh response. Check the endpoint, UART settings and competing bus readers.
error.unsupported_meter: The meter manufacturer, device version or record profile is not supported.
error.wrong_meter: This endpoint answers for another meter. Existing energy history cannot be reassigned to it.

abort.already_configured: This meter or TCP bridge is already configured.

init.title: Polling options
init.description: Polling is serialized. Slow responses and bounded retries may extend the actual interval. Two seconds is the tested starting point; this is polling, not push.
